sections.h1Lead: Free AI Automation Audit for Kerala Businesses:
sections.h1Accent: Find What AI Can Do for You

body.text: A free AI automation audit from Teknoppy shows you exactly which tasks in your business AI can automate, what each one would cost, how much time it could save and where to start. You get a practical, written plan from our Kochi team, with no obligation to buy anything.
We run audits for businesses in Kerala, across India and overseas, in person at our Thykoodam office or online.

sections.trustline: Reviewed by Sanal Edison, Founder, Teknoppy. Last updated: 17 November 2026.

items.text: Teknoppy: web, software and automation studio in Thykoodam, Kochi, since 2018
What you get: process review, opportunity list, ROI estimate and a prioritised roadmap
120+ websites delivered; 4.9/5 on Google from 60+ reviews
12 in-house staff; no outsourced work
Typical time: 1 to 2 weeks from first call to written report

paragraphs.text: Many businesses know AI could help but are unsure where. Some buy tools that never get used. Others start with a complex project when a simple automation would have paid back faster. A short, structured review prevents both mistakes.

The free AI automation audit works as an AI readiness assessment and an AI opportunity assessment in one. It looks at how your team works today, what data you have, which tools you use and where time is being lost, then turns that into clear recommendations.

sections.h2: What Happens in an AI Automation Audit?
sections.intro: What happens in an AI automation audit is simple and practical. There are no long questionnaires or sales presentations.

items.title: AI Strategy Session
items.text: The audit starts with an AI strategy session of about 60 to 90 minutes with the business owner and, ideally, one or two people who handle daily operations. We discuss goals, pain points, busy periods and the tasks that frustrate your team most.

items.title: Process Audit for Automation
items.text: Next comes a process audit for automation. We look closely at three to five key workflows, such as enquiry handling, order processing, invoicing, reporting or customer support, and note every step, delay and handover.

items.title: AI Tool Stack Review
items.text: The AI tool stack review checks the software you already use, including your website, CRM, accounting, WhatsApp, email and spreadsheets. We identify which tools connect easily, which subscriptions overlap and whether AI features you already pay for are being ignored.

items.title: AI Data Readiness Check
items.text: An AI data readiness check looks at whether your information is complete, consistent and accessible enough for automation. Clean, well-organised data makes AI far more reliable, so we flag any gaps that should be fixed first.

items.title: Automation ROI Estimate
items.text: For each opportunity, we prepare an automation ROI estimate based on time spent today, likely time saved, build cost and running costs. This helps you compare options on business value, not just interest.

items.title: AI Automation Roadmap
items.text: Finally, we deliver an AI automation roadmap that ranks opportunities into quick wins, medium projects and longer-term ideas, with suggested timelines and budgets for each.

sections.h2: What You Receive After the Audit
sections.intro: What you receive after the audit is a written report you can keep and use, whether or not you work with us. It typically includes:

items.text: A summary of your current processes and main time drains
A list of automation opportunities with effort and impact ratings
Estimated costs, time savings and payback periods
Recommended tools and integrations
A step-by-step roadmap for the next three to twelve months
Data and security points to address

outro.text: We walk you through the report on a short call and answer any questions. If you want to see the format first, ask for an AI audit report sample with client details removed.

sections.h2: Is the AI Audit Really Free?

paragraphs.text: Is the AI audit really free? Yes. The free AI automation audit has no fee and no obligation. We offer it because businesses that understand their options make better decisions, and many choose to work with us afterwards. If you decide to build the recommendations yourself or with another provider, the report is still yours.

The free audit covers a focused review of your key workflows. Very large organisations that need a detailed review of many departments may need a paid AI automation consulting engagement, and we will tell you upfront if that applies.

sections.h2: How Long Does an AI Audit Take?
sections.intro: How long does an AI audit take? For most small and medium businesses, the full process takes one to two weeks:

items.title: Booking and short intake form (same day)
items.text: Tell us about your business and goals.

items.title: Strategy session (60 to 90 minutes)
items.text: In person in Kochi or by video call.

items.title: Process and tool review (3 to 5 working days)
items.text: We study workflows, tools and sample data.

items.title: Report preparation (2 to 3 working days)
items.text: We build the opportunity list, estimates and roadmap.

items.title: Results call (30 to 45 minutes)
items.text: We walk you through the report and next steps.

paragraphs.text: Your team usually spends only two to three hours in total, so the audit does not disrupt daily work.

items.title: AI Audit for Small Businesses
items.text: An AI audit for small businesses focuses on affordable, quick wins, such as automating enquiry replies, follow-ups, invoices, appointment reminders and simple reports. Small teams often see the biggest relative benefit because every hour saved matters.

items.title: AI Audit for Manufacturers
items.text: An AI audit for manufacturers looks at order processing, purchase orders, inventory updates, quality records, dispatch documents and dealer communication, where manual data entry and paperwork slow operations down.

paragraphs.text: The same approach works for clinics, schools, travel agencies, retailers, logistics companies and professional service firms.

An AI automation consultation is a single conversation about ideas. The free audit goes further, with a structured review, numbers and a written plan. Ongoing AI automation consulting suits businesses that want help over months to plan, select tools and manage several projects. Most businesses start with the audit and decide from there.

paragraphs.html: Local clients can also ask for a free AI consultation Kochi businesses can attend at our office if they only want to discuss one specific idea first.

sections.intro: Every business is different, but some opportunities appear in almost every audit:

items.html: Enquiry handling: Website, WhatsApp and phone enquiries answered instantly and logged automatically, so no lead is missed after hours.
Follow-ups: Quotes, reminders and payment requests sent on schedule instead of relying on someone remembering.
Document data: Details from invoices, purchase orders and forms read by AI and entered into accounting or ERP software.
Reporting: Weekly sales, stock and performance summaries compiled and sent automatically.
Internal requests: Leave, purchase and expense approvals routed and tracked without email chains.

outro.text: In many cases, the first quick win can be live within two to four weeks of the audit, which lets you see results before deciding on bigger projects.

sections.h2: How to Prepare for Your Free AI Automation Audit

paragraphs.text: You do not need to prepare much, but a few things help us give sharper recommendations. Make a short list of the tasks your team repeats most often, note which software you use, and, if possible, share a few sample documents, such as an invoice, an order form or a typical customer enquiry, with sensitive details removed. Rough numbers are enough: how many enquiries, orders or invoices you handle each week and roughly how long each takes.

sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for Your Free AI Automation Audit?

items.title: Practical, Not Theoretical
items.text: Our recommendations come from a team that builds websites, software and automations every day. We suggest only what we know can be built, maintained and used by your staff.

items.title: Honest About Limits
items.text: If AI is not the right fit for a task, we say so. Some problems are better solved by fixing a process, training staff or using a simple rule-based tool.

items.title: Trusted Local Team
items.text: The free AI automation audit Kerala businesses book with us is run by our own team in Thykoodam, Kochi. Shainesh Prakashan, CEO of Exacore IT at Infopark Kochi, says Teknoppy "was very intuitive in understanding our requirements," which is exactly what an audit needs.

items.q: Do I need technical knowledge to take part?
items.a: No. We explain everything in plain language. You only need to know how your business works day to day.

items.q: Will you share our business information?
items.a: No. Everything you share stays confidential and is used only to prepare your audit. We are happy to sign a non-disclosure agreement before the session.

items.q: Can international businesses take the audit?
items.a: Yes. We run audits online for clients outside India, with sessions scheduled to suit your time zone.
You choose. You can implement the roadmap yourself, ask us for a quote on specific items or simply keep the report for future planning. There is no follow-up pressure.

items.q: Is the audit only about AI?
items.a: No. We look at the whole workflow. Sometimes the best fix is a simple rule-based automation, a better form, a shared inbox or a small change in who does what. AI is recommended only where it adds clear value over simpler options, and the report explains why in each case.
